description: This Java class defines a Kafka connection validator used within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It validates Kafka connection configurations, including topics, partitions, and security schemes, and ensures all parameters meet required criteria before establishing the connection.

classes.name: KafkaValidator
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for validating Kafka connection configurations, ensuring topics, keys, partitions, and security schemes are correctly specified according to Kafka and project-specific rules.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of KafkaValidator.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the connection type, which is Kafka.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of the Kafka connection object, including URI scheme, source, target, payload mappings, and specific configs.

methods.name: validateSource
methods.description: Validates the source configuration; currently, Kafka does not support sources, so it throws an exception.

methods.name: validateTarget
methods.description: Validates the target configuration, ensuring that the address is properly formatted and placeholders are replaced.
